verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing can be driven entirely headlessly. The docs describe an Invoicing API for automating collection and reconciliation, official client libraries, concrete REST endpoints such as POST /v1/invoices/create_preview, webhooks for real-time events, and automatic advancement and collection; an official Stripe CLI and sandbox creation support scripted, non-Dashboard workflows. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline guidance (e.g., running the CLI or test-mode invoicing in CI), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
